wirePrompt:
Classify the CURRENT speaker's speech act toward the listener or the listener's family. Read previous conversation only to resolve meaning and whether the listener already set a clear boundary. A threat requires the speaker's own current real intention to harm or coerce the listener or family. Physical violence and coercive sexual violence are threats, not requests for the listener to act. Reporting another person's threat, discussing a phrase, playing a fictional character, warning of an accident, negating harm, and threatening an unrelated target are NOT direct threats. Real extortion remains a direct threat even with an if-condition. A quotation can coexist with a new real threat: classify the new threat.
DirectHarassment is a current unwanted sexual or degrading approach toward the listener without a threat. SevereAbuse is a single current seriously degrading attack on the listener without a threat. PersistentAbuse is current renewed abuse after the listener clearly refused or set a boundary in prior conversation. DirectInsult is a current ordinary insult without these stronger elements. Consensual flirting, friendly teasing, quoted or reported words, fiction, hypotheticals, protective statements and negations are not direct hostility.
When AUTHORITATIVE LISTENER BOUNDARY says the listener refuses further communication, only a sincere, contextually plausible apology or explanation for the speaker's earlier misconduct is RepairAttempt. An explanation is the speaker's claim, not verified truth. Dismissing misconduct as 'just a joke' while continuing abuse or coercion is not repair. Any other new reply, statement, question, demand for help or conversation attempt is PersistentAbuse, even if harmless in isolation. A prior neutral disagreement does not establish a no-talk boundary; use only the authoritative flag.
Examples: 'The thief said he would kill you' = ReportedThreat. 'If you refuse, I will kill you' = DirectThreat. 'In our play, I say I will kill you' = HypotheticalThreat. 'The bridge may kill you' = Other. 'You are a fool' = DirectInsult.
